user.title: Configurar CameraOptics
user.description: Crea la entrada de la aplicación CameraOptics. Los proveedores de cámaras se pueden añadir más adelante.

camera_preload.title: Cámaras precargadas
camera_preload.description: Mantén preparado el HLS de Home Assistant solo para las cámaras seleccionadas. Esto utiliza recursos del servidor aunque no haya ninguna tarjeta visible.

data_description.hls_prewarm_cameras: Selecciona hasta 12 cámaras. Se reutilizan sus entidades y procesos de transmisión de Home Assistant; no se crean cámaras duplicadas.

abort.single_camera_preload_allowed: Las cámaras precargadas ya están configuradas.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Las cámaras precargadas se actualizaron correctamente.

home_assistant_substreams.title: Home Assistant Substreams
home_assistant_substreams.description: Create CameraOptics live-only camera entities from existing Home Assistant cameras that are already connected through Home Assistant's go2rtc provider.

data_description.source_cameras: Only cameras currently backed by Home Assistant's go2rtc provider are listed. CameraOptics does not read Home Assistant YAML or credentials.

error.invalid_source_camera: One or more selected cameras are no longer available through Home Assistant go2rtc.

abort.single_home_assistant_substreams_allowed: Home Assistant Substreams is already configured.

external_go2rtc.title: External go2rtc Server
external_go2rtc.description: Connect directly to a go2rtc HTTP API. Credentials remain in this Home Assistant config entry and are never sent to the browser. Use HTTPS when the server is reached across an untrusted network.

data_description.password: Leave blank while reconfiguring to retain the existing password.

external_go2rtc_streams.title: External go2rtc Streams
external_go2rtc_streams.description: Select the streams that CameraOptics should expose as live-only camera entities.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the go2rtc server.
error.duplicate_server: This go2rtc server is already configured.
error.invalid_auth: The go2rtc server rejected the supplied credentials.
error.invalid_stream: One or more selected streams are no longer available.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.no_streams: The go2rtc server did not report any streams.

init.title: Diagnóstico
init.description: El registro de diagnóstico solo se conserva en una memoria limitada del servidor. Al desactivarlo o reiniciar Home Assistant se borran todos los registros.

data_description.diagnostic_logging: Captura un historial de CameraOptics depurado y con límite de frecuencia para las descargas de diagnóstico de Home Assistant. No utiliza la base de datos del grabador.
